title: Fig and the Pond
note: b415 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters nd, nt, nk.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar sitting on a leaf at the edge of a round pond.
Fig the caterpillar looking across the pond at bright flowers on the far bank.
Fig the caterpillar looking down worriedly at the water, shaking his head.
Fig the caterpillar crawling along the grassy edge, going around the pond.
Fig the caterpillar crawling over a patch of damp sand by the water.
Leaves and grass blowing sideways in a sudden gust of wind near the pond.
Fig the caterpillar gripping tight to a stem, pressing on despite the wind.
Fig the caterpillar arriving at last among the bright flowers on the far bank.
Fig the caterpillar curled up asleep in warm sunshine among the flowers.
